name: Define the cultural labor score
text_content:
Type: founder decision

Source: Session 3 of the Scaling People translation program, page section 8.5 of the S3 page in the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253. Session task 86ajgmhgx.

The white paper (p.22) names three leading indicators and gives the cultural labor score one line: "beyond hours and cost, how the team is actually doing." It is a charter metric candidate and the least defined of the three. The team specifies what it must do: read bandwidth rather than output, be captured at service tempo rather than annually, and not reduce to hours. Brandon, who originated the concept, supplies what it is: the question or observation it is built from, the population, and the rhythm.
